item.title: Five men, four already serving life, to stand trial over Larnaca armed robbery
item.description: Five men, four of whom are already serving life sentences for murder, have been referred to trial before the Permanent Criminal Court in Larnaca over an armed robbery at a businessman’s home in Larnaca two years ago. item.title: Tarique Rahman sworn in as Bangladesh’s PM after landslide election victory
item.description: Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Tarique Rahman was sworn in as prime minister on Tuesday, marking an important political shift in the South Asian nation following a period of turmoil.
